description: Partial discharge monitoring system with up to 6 UHF, IEC or AE channels
source: Maschinenfabrik Reinhausen, "MSENSE PDM Operating instructions", 12636773/00 EN (2025-11), section 9.2.2.1

sources.title: MSENSE PDM Monitoring system, Operating instructions

notes: Manufactured for MR by BSS Hochspannungstechnik as the PDM-600.
Modbus TCP on port 502; the unit id is fixed at 0. Read-only: discrete inputs and input registers.
The unit of a PD value depends on the channel type: V (UHF without sensor calibration), V/m (UHF with calibration), C (IEC) or V (AE).
Channels are numbered UHF first, then IEC, then AE; read Hardware configuration to see which channel is which.
